title: Digi International to Release Third Fiscal Quarter 2026 Earnings Results via Video Conference Call on August 5, 2026
summary: Digi will release its financial results for the third fiscal quarter 2026 on Wednesday, August 5, after market close, at approximately 4:00 p.m. ET.
body_markdown: Digi will release its financial results for the third fiscal quarter 2026 on Wednesday, August 5, after market close, at approximately 4:00 p.m. ET.
